messages:
Zara: Need a compact launch creative set for the benchmark webinar on May 14. Ask: hero (1200x628) + hero-alt for email (600x200), three micro-tiles (1080x1080) that showcase: 1) cost savings, 2) latency improvements, 3) routing/fallback. Plus a single-slide explainer (16:9) and a gated one-pager. Timeline: first comps Wed EOD.
Felix: I'll take lead on art direction. Quick decisions: tone = punchy/technical hybrid, palette = brand primary + high-contrast accent. Any required legal footers?
Rae: Legal: add line "Internal Redwood Inference testing; results vary by workload" on one-pager footer. No competitor logos. Also need GDPR consent language in gated PDF.
product-bot: Data snippet: use sample metrics from drive: drive.redwood/bench/launch_sample_2025.csv. Callouts: median latency, p95, cost/token.
Zara: Routing: hero buttons -> [Register] and [Download benchmark]. Register -> /events?utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=bench_launch; Download -> gated form (collect name, company, email, role). Include hidden utm_campaign=bench_launch_2025.
Felix: Design notes: slide should be export-friendly (SVG + PNG), include an area for presenter to animate throughput bands. Micro-tiles must have alt text and a short copy line (<=12 words). GIFs must be under 500KB.
design-squad: We'll produce Figma frames and a handoff checklist. Plan: wireframes Mon, first comps Wed EOD, final assets Thu. Will include light/dark safe variants and accessibility checks.
Rae: Also confirm translations for FR/DE/ES. Zara will supply copy by Tue noon.
Zara: Yep, sending copy pack Tue 10am. Also want an embeddable 300x250 banner for partner pages.
Felix: Noted. Will center-focus key art so it crops well.
design-squad: Uploading initial frames to Figma: figma.com/file/benchlaunch2025. We'll flag any deviations from brand tokens.
Zara: Great. Please drop export names & bucket path when ready (marketing-exports/bench_launch_2025/...). Thanks! :rocket:
